review:
Ancient Island Megaways sits on a 6x7 grid with a row of reel modifiers above it. Every spin, modifiers can offer cash prizes up to 100x, multipliers up to 100x, an expanded grid with maximum ways, an extra wild reel, or replacement of all non-winning symbols.

Wilds landing on reels 2 to 5 expand to fill their reel and trigger the modifier above that reel. Four to six scatters award 12 to 16 free spins, where four modifiers land on every spin and a new modifier adding 3–10 free spins joins the options. Pragmatic Play advertises up to 10,000x. The RTP is 96.55%. The modifier row gives every wild a visible consequence.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
